visualCharacteristics.structure: contained banner photo; white title card overlapping its bottom-right two-thirds; breadcrumbs in the left third below the photo (stacked image, card, breadcrumbs on mobile)

sourceNotes.variantReason: campaign-hero 0.15, hero-cta 0.15 (light inline-photo banner with overlapping title card vs dark full-bleed heroes). New variant.
sourceNotes.reuse: Identical on every newsroom dossier and on the /newsroom/dossiers/ listing page; breadcrumbs are derived from the URL so the same authored content works on all of them.

contentPattern.structure: row 1 banner image (+alt); row 2 rich text with the card heading (e.g. h2 'Retrouvez nos décryptages'); optional list of links in row 2 overrides the automatic breadcrumbs (Accueil > parent > current page title)
